questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial clause.
options: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped they began the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped did they began the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped they began the journey.
questions.answer: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin the journey.

questions.question: Which option correctly forms a cleft sentence to emphasize the location?
options: It was in the old castle that the treasure was hidden.
It was in the old castle where the treasure was hidden.
It was in the old castle that the treasure was hidden.
It was in the old castle, that the treasure was hidden.
questions.answer: It was in the old castle that the treasure was hidden.

questions.question: Select the correct form of the subjunctive mood in the following sentence: 'If only I ________ more time to explore the museum.'
options: had
have
had had
would have

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses ellipsis to maintain grammatical parallelism?
options: She likes painting, dancing, and to play the piano.
She likes painting, dancing, and playing the piano.
She likes painting, dancing, and to be playing the piano.
She likes painting, dancing, and to have played the piano.
questions.answer: She likes painting, dancing, and playing the piano.

questions.question: Choose the option that demonstrates the correct formal register for the given context: 'It is imperative that the committee ________ their decision by the end of the week.'
options: makes
will make
made
shall make
